# Who you get matched against

Matchmaking looks for an opponent with a **similar trophy count**, and _usually_ within a few hundred trophies. See the [live rankings](/leaderboards/tracked) for where you sit.

## What the numbers show

1. Most attacks land within 150 trophies.
2. Very few cross 400 trophies.
3. Early in the Legend day the gaps are wider.

- Defenses are matched the same way.
- A full day has eight attacks and eight defenses.

| Trophy gap | Share of attacks | Average stars |
| ---------- | ---------------: | ------------: |
| 0–50       |            41.2% |          2.31 |
| 51–150     |            38.7% |          2.27 |
| 151–400    |            18.9% |          2.19 |
| Over 400   |             1.2% |          2.02 |

> Matchmaking does not look at your Town Hall level once you reach Legend League.

```text
gap = |attacker trophies - defender trophies|
```
